characters.name: Jahn
characters.voice_notes: Researcher at the Freetown Economics Institute and Seila's friend. Casual, curious, a little out of the loop; shaken in chapter 15.

characters.name: Utaku
characters.voice_notes: Well-informed, matter-of-fact doctoral student at the Institute; explains politics briskly.

characters.name: news reporter
characters.origin: unknown (special broadcast seen in Freetown and Meldan)
characters.voice_notes: Broadcast reporter relaying the invasion of Redshire; urgent, grave news-bulletin delivery. The lines are marked as narrator quote runs.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, mother, economics-and-culture blogger. Warm, playful, quick; fond of Dzego; protective of the children.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters; newly made Keeper in the Order. Thoughtful, earnest, slightly awkward, argues carefully. Inside Keeper booths he is addressed by a number (Four, Six or Two depending on the circle).

characters.name: Mov
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's friend and fellow Keeper who shadows Delwart for him. Dry, wry, security-minded, speaks in confident clipped statements. Usually heard over a call.

characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Bright, intense, earnest; maths-minded Minpentai prodigy now studying cryptography; protagonist of the Dzego chapters. Proud but self-aware, eager to please his mentors.

characters.name: Deluin
characters.voice_notes: Foreign contestant at the Minpentai nationals; friendly, confident, witty, a little lecturing; becomes Zei's friend. In chapter 15 he is only heard through written messages from occupied Redshire.

characters.name: Su
characters.age: older adult (an older woman about the same age as Mu)
characters.voice_notes: Lead Minpentai priest and organizer of the nationals; gracious, composed host; gentle but firm when delivering bad news in chapter 15.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: Cloaked Minpentai priest, High Council member of the Kungaupei (secret defense society). Soft-spoken, measured, mentor-like; lectures on cryptography and assumes compliance.

notes: Many lines are written messages: 15:22 (Seila to Jahn), 15:27 and 15:30 (Jahn), all Z lines 15:56-15:98 (Zei to Deluin) and all of Deluin's lines (15:61, 15:65, 15:72, 15:91, 15:94, 15:102, 15:146). D is Den for the spoken scene 15:127-15:153, Deluin for the messages. S is Su for 15:108-15:118 and Seila only at 15:22. M is Mov (call with Gladias). narrator_exceptions: the quote runs at 15:9, 15:11 and 15:13 are the broadcast reporter speaking aloud (the narration says Jahn listens to 'the reporter'); they are marked N, so I list them even though the speaker's label does not start with N - drop them if you want the narrator to read the bulletin. 15:7 is the on-screen headline and is left as narration.
